zh.title: 國防部偵獲3架次中國軍機越臺灣海峽中線 同期另偵獲9艘中國軍艦
zh.summary: 國防部偵獲3架次中國軍機越臺灣海峽中線，另偵獲9艘中國軍艦。
body: 臺灣國防部11月24日上午公佈軍機、軍艦動態，統計顯示，自前一天上午6時至當天上午6時，偵獲3架次中國軍機逾越臺灣海峽中線，進入臺灣西南及東側空域。
同一時段內，國防部也偵獲9艘中國軍艦。國防部表示，國軍運用執行任務的軍機、軍艦及岸置飛彈系統，對相關動態嚴密監控與應處。
本站統計紀錄的前一次資料為11月23日，列有中國軍機5架次及中國軍艦12艘。這些歷史資料由本站依國防部歷日公開統計自行記錄。

en.title: Taiwan reports 3 Chinese military flights across Taiwan Strait median line and 9 Chinese warships
en.summary: Taiwan's defense ministry reports three Chinese military flights across the Taiwan Strait median line and nine Chinese warships.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said on the morning of Nov. 24 that it detected three Chinese military aircraft sorties crossing the Taiwan Strait median line and entering airspace southwest and east of Taiwan. The reporting period ran from 6 a.m. the previous day to 6 a.m. that day.

The ministry also detected nine Chinese military vessels during the period. It said Taiwan's armed forces used aircraft and vessels on assignment, as well as shore-based missile systems, to closely monitor the activity and respond.

SKYTICAL's own statistical records show that the previous entry, dated Nov. 23, listed five Chinese military aircraft sorties and 12 Chinese military vessels. The site compiles the figures from the defense ministry's public daily statistics.
